object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. Covers under itself and under a descendant. Before or after a descendant, and an unchanged outline after the refusal, are gaps.
object.description: Move a top-level heading under itself, and move it under its own sub-object, in the library and through the move_object tool. Expected: each move is refused, saying that the object would go under itself or under one of its descendants.
